cards.answer: Draven is an AD marksman who repeatedly empowers basic attacks by catching Spinning Axes and uses Blood Rush for movement and attack speed. Champion kills cash in his accumulated Adoration for bonus gold.
cards.counterplay: Pressure his axe landing spots and avoid feeding him champion kills.

cards.answer: League of Draven builds Adoration when Draven catches axes or kills minions, monsters, or turrets. Champion kills consume his Adoration for bonus gold; dying loses some of his stacks.
cards.counterplay: Avoid risky fights that could give him a cash-in; pressure him before he secures a champion kill.

citations.quote: Draven gains an Adoration stack when he catches a Spinning Axe or kills a minion, monster, or turret.

facts.claim: League of Draven builds Adoration when Draven catches axes or kills minions, monsters, or turrets.

citations.quote: When Draven kills an enemy champion, he consumes all Adoration stacks to gain bonus gold.
He loses Adoration stacks when he dies.

facts.claim: Champion kills consume his Adoration for bonus gold; dying loses some of his stacks.

cards.priority_reason: Champion kills can convert accumulated stacks into a gold advantage.

cards.answer: Spinning Axe empowers a basic attack with bonus physical damage, then bounces to a landing spot determined by Draven's movement. Catching it readies another empowered attack; he can hold two Spinning Axes at once. Both teams can see the ground landing cue.
cards.counterplay: Aim pressure at landing spots to make catching axes dangerous.

citations.quote: Active: Draven's next basic attack will throw an axe, dealing bonus physical damage.
Upon hitting the target, the axe then ricochets off of them to land after roughly 1.4 seconds, with the location being determined by Draven's current movement.

facts.claim: Spinning Axe empowers a basic attack with bonus physical damage, then bounces to a landing spot determined by Draven's movement.

citations.quote: If Draven catches it, he automatically readies another Spinning Axe. Draven can have two Spinning Axes at once.

facts.claim: Catching it readies another empowered attack; he can hold two Spinning Axes at once.

citations.quote: Spinning Axe will place a visual cue on the ground where it will land. This visual cue is visible to both teams

facts.claim: Both teams can see the ground landing cue.

passive_visual.description: Tentative cue: a ground marker at an axe's landing spot.

cards.priority_reason: Axe catches sustain his empowered attacks and reveal places he may move toward.

cards.answer: Blood Rush grants attack speed and a rapidly fading movement speed boost. Catching a Spinning Axe resets its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance during his speed burst and pressure axe catches to limit repeated casts.

citations.quote: Draven gains increased Move Speed and Attack Speed. The Move Speed bonus decreases rapidly over its duration.

facts.claim: Blood Rush grants attack speed and a rapidly fading movement speed boost.

citations.quote: Catching a Spinning Axe resets Blood Rush's cooldown.

facts.claim: Catching a Spinning Axe resets its cooldown.

cards.priority_reason: Axe catches can repeatedly restore his chase and attack speed tool.

cards.answer: Stand Aside throws axes in a line, dealing physical damage, knocking enemies aside, and slowing them.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the axes and be cautious about approaching while this ability is available.

citations.quote: Active: Draven throws a fan of axes in a line in the target direction that deal physical damage to enemies hit, knocking them aside and slowing them.

facts.claim: Stand Aside throws axes in a line, dealing physical damage, knocking enemies aside, and slowing them.

cards.priority_reason: Displacement and slowing help him control an approach or chase.

cards.answer: Whirling Death sends axes outward and back to Draven, dealing physical damage on each pass. They reverse after hitting an enemy champion, or Draven can recall them early. Damage decreases as they hit enemies and resets on reversal; champions damaged to or below a health threshold equal to his Adoration stacks are executed.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the outgoing axes and watch their return path; retreat cautiously when low on health.

citations.quote: Active: Draven hurls forth two massive axes that deal physical damage to enemies hit.
Recast: Whirling Death slowly reverses direction and homes back to Draven, dealing physical damage to enemies hit.

facts.claim: Whirling Death sends axes outward and back to Draven, dealing physical damage on each pass.

citations.quote: Whirling Death slowly reverses direction and returns to Draven after striking an enemy champion. Draven may also activate this ability while the axes are in flight to cause it to return early.

facts.claim: They reverse after hitting an enemy champion, or Draven can recall them early.

citations.quote: Whirling Death deals 100% – 50% (based on enemies hit) damage, resetting upon reversing direction.
Enemy champions that are damaged to or while below a health threshold equal to the number of Adoration stacks are executed.

facts.claim: Damage decreases as they hit enemies and resets on reversal; champions damaged to or below a health threshold equal to his Adoration stacks are executed.

cards.priority_reason: The return pass and stack-based execute matter when dodging or retreating.
